# vfx-mcp

> FastMCP 3.4+ FFmpeg video effects server (port 11122). Translates natural language effect descriptions into FFmpeg filter complex strings.

**Full doc (tools, env, config):** [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)

## Entry

- Python package: `src/vfx_mcp/` — `server.py` (FastMCP + FastAPI), `tools/effects.py` (portmanteau `vfx_apply`), `services/ffmpeg_effects.py` (filter builders)
- Dual transport: stdio (`--stdio`) and HTTP (`--serve`, `/mcp`)
- Config: `.env.example` (prefix `VFX_MCP_`)

## Quick Start

```powershell
uv sync
uv run python -m vfx_mcp --stdio
```
